candidate_coarse_stage_policy.workspace_budget: Sequential saturated subtraction from capacity of min(checkpointBudget, capacity/2), min(2 GiB, capacity/16), and estimatedWorkingBytes(model,size).
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.active_block_admission: 72 times input bytes must fit the resolved workspace budget; frozen forward-block admission remains unchanged.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.graph_owner_consistency: The same resolved UInt64 budget is used by initial, rebuilt and disposable compiler owners.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.compiled_code_identity: Includes the active execution variant and resolved workspace budget when active grouping is enabled, because explicit checkpoint budgets can change cuts.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.stream_isolation: Drain before and after each marked active forward/reverse stage, including replay, errors and cancellation; submission storage remains owned until GPU completion.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.measurement_note: The adaptive-rank8-512, adaptive-rank8-1024 and adaptive-output-rank8-1024 reports use this final source. Earlier coarse/RRDB reports predate shared-headroom and active-stage isolation.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.memory_limitation: Workspace formulas are conservative admission estimates, not guarantees of actual backend peak allocation.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.remaining_candidate: Adaptive active-block grouping is enabled through 1K subject to memory admission; explicit false override or TEXTURE_STUDIO_COALESCE_ACTIVE_BLOCKS=0 retains fine cuts. Saved grid/scope/rank/alpha are preserved.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.historical_rejected_rrdb_admission: Workspace estimate must fit min(24 GiB, capacity/2, resolved workspace budget).
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.rrdb_experiment_status: Rejected after broader-scope optimizer regression; implementation and flag removed.
candidate_coarse_stage_policy.historical_rrdb_isolation: The rejected RRDB experiment used the same drain-before/drain-after scheduling.
